mentions.name: Rebels in the sky
mentions.description: A terminal-based basketball manager game about space pirates playing basketball. It runs in the command line, works offline with no internet connection, and can also be tried via SSH.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I keep working on my command line game 'Rebels in the sky' (https://rebels.frittura.org)

The game is about spacepirates playing basketball, it's kinda a basketball manager game. It's played in your terminal and works with no internet.

mentions.name: Rebels in the Sky
mentions.description: A terminal-based basketball management game about space pirates playing basketball across the galaxy. It is a P2P game with no central server, built on top of libp2p, and runs as a terminal application; it can be tried over SSH without installing, downloaded from its site, or run from the open-source repository.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working for a while on a command line game about spacepirates playing basketball across the galaxy. The game is a basketball managerial game with some pirate-y stuff. It's a P2P game with no central server, built on top of libp2p.
